question: Which of the following is Uttarakhand's first gravity dam?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Song Dam__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• It is originally built on the** Song River, the dam is about 148 meters high.**
 
• It aims to generate **power up to six megawatts**.
 
• **Dhora Dam** is located near dineshpur constructed on river** dhora**, Length of the Dam is **9700 m and Volume of the dam is 50.700 * 10³ m³.**
 
• **The Tehri Dam** is the tallest dam in India. It is a multi-purpose rock and earth-fill embankment dam on **the Bhagirathi River near Tehri in Uttarakhand.**
